verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is estimated to cost over $4 billion for a single launch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'each Artemis launch costs more than $4 billion'; R3: 'Each launch costs around US$4 billion'; R5: '$4.1 billion per launch'; R6: '$4.1 billion per launch'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Artemis launches (including II) cost more than or around $4B+.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission cost covers the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion capsule.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'This includes the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and the Orion spacecraft'; R6: 'SLS/Orion system'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state Artemis II costs include SLS rocket and Orion.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is part of the NASA Artemis program.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All sources describe Artemis II as a mission within the Artemis program, e.g., R1: 'Artemis 2 is just one mission within NASA’s broader Artemis program'; R4: 'Artemis II (April 1, 2026)' under Artemis program.

verifications.claim: The NASA Artemis program is projected to cost roughly $93 billion through 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '$93 billion through 2025'; R3: 'US$93 billion so far'; R4: 'US$93 billion (2012–2025)'; R5: '$93 billion up to fiscal year 2025'; R6: 'nearly $93 billion through 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Exact figure repeatedly cited for Artemis program through 2025.

verifications.claim: NASA Office of Inspector General (OIG) estimates the total launch cost for Artemis II at approximately $4.1 to $4.2 billion per mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: '2021 audit from NASA’s Office of Inspector General ... $4.1 billion per launch'; R6: 'NASA's Office of Inspector General ... $4.1 billion per launch'
verifications.reasoning: OIG cited for $4.1B per launch (Artemis missions incl. II); 4.1-4.2 is approximate match.

verifications.claim: The Orion capsule for the first two flights is projected to cost $9.3 billion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'projected cost of Orion through the second Artemis flight will reach $9.3 billion'
verifications.reasoning: Direct match for Orion cost through first two Artemis flights.

verifications.claim: The overall multi-year Artemis program is estimated to cost $93 billion through 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '$93 billion through 2025'; R3: 'US$93 billion'; R4: 'US$93 billion (2012–2025)'; R5: '$93 billion up to fiscal year 2025'; R6: '$93 billion through 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Precise figure consistently attributed to overall Artemis program.

verifications.claim: The cost of Artemis II includes the SLS rocket, Orion crew capsule, and ground support systems
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and the Orion spacecraft'; R6: 'SLS/Orion system ... Ground systems will cost another $568 million per year'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm SLS, Orion, and ground systems as components of per-launch costs.
